verdict.rationale: Muse is a consumer agent service, so offering outbound webhooks is a fair question, but the evidence documents no registrable HTTP callbacks a programmatic consumer could receive. What it does show is adjacent: the agent itself reacts to events, it sends in-app notifications, and it can write custom connectors. Probes also found no public API spec or keyless developer surface (llms.txt and openapi.json return 401, api.muse.ai returns 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
